notes: COILED. Intro: the flame curl coils tighter, then lashes open and throws off a white ember that drifts up and away. Two-hue plant without an exception: the calyx, stem and sepal claw are the index-1 green, the pod is the index-2 red shaded with black. Sport: 'Black Pearl'. Capsicum annuum 'Black Pearl' (USDA, AAS winner 2006): near-black leaves, glossy black fruit, purple flowers (indexes 1-2 only).
